items.title: Henry "Jack" Palmer Interview
items.q: I remember that you told somebody you know the personnel of the Buddy Doyle recordings. That's right. I was on them. You took part. I was on them.

ctx.x: $35. $35 and a little money. $35. $5.11. This Roosevelt Place.
He don't need the entire produce money to go out and fishing. He loves to fish. You know what I'm saying? He gets on that bicycle.

You met him in Memphis? Yep. Well, I'm very interested in the blues scene in Memphis. There are some guys who made recordings which are somewhat mysterious. I remember that you told somebody you know the personnel of the Buddy Doyle recordings. That's right. I was on them. You took part. I was on them.
